# Exon masks for the RNA readout. alphagenome_research is not on PyPI; it pulls
# in jax. Its pybigwig dependency does not build on Windows, where it can be
# installed with --no-deps followed by jax, jaxtyping and chex.
alphagenome_research @ git+https://github.com/google-deepmind/alphagenome_research.git
